app.name: Main App
app.summary:
An App Router surface that combines page and layout code into the site's entry point.

Defines Home, RootLayout, metadata, viewport, and the mode switching actions openPlace, browse, and scan.

Rendered by Next.js on request and client navigation.

Consumes the Explore UI, Place Data, and Geo Motion Library.

components components/ui.name: UI Toolkit
components components/ui.summary:
A React design system of reusable components and providers for consistent UI.

Exports Button, Sidebar, ThemeProvider, toast primitives, and many form and navigation controls.

Pure component library used by client code.

Used by Behavior Hooks and the app shell.

hooks.name: React Hooks
hooks.summary:
A hook library for browser specific state and notifications.

Implements toast state, dispatch, and mobile breakpoint detection through useToast and useIsMobile.

Runs in the browser when React components mount.

Builds on the UI Kit and supports its toast and mobile behavior.

lib.name: Shared Utils
lib.summary:
A tiny shared helper module for composing CSS class names.

Exports cn from lib/utils.ts for UI components to merge classes safely.

Pure library with no runtime of its own.

Used by the UI Kit.

src/components.name: Panorama Viewer
src/components.summary:
A set of interactive React feature components for choosing and viewing places.

Defines Explore, PlacePicker, PanoramaViewer, Splash, and motion permission handling for the app experience.

Runs in the browser as interactive client components.

Builds on Place Data and Geo Motion Library, and is used by the App Shell.
src/components.role: Coordinates place browsing and panorama flow.

src/lib.name: Game Formatting Utils
src/lib.summary:
A utility module for geographic math, device motion, stitching, and formatting.

Implements haversineKm, nearestPlace, getPosition, watchHeading, stitchEquirect, canvasToBlob, resizeBlob, and display formatters.

Pure library with browser and canvas helpers.

Builds on Place Data and feeds the App Shell and Explore UI.

src/data.name: Places Catalog
src/data.summary:
A static data model for named places and their tidbits.

Exports Place, Tidbit, TidbitKind, and the places collection consumed throughout the app.

Build time data module.

Read by Explore UI, Geo Motion Library, and App Shell.

app/api.name: Generate API
app/api.summary:
A server route that accepts POST requests and returns generated output.

Sets runtime limits, constrains years with MIN_YEAR and MAX_YEAR, and builds the prompt in route POST.

Serverless route executed per request.

Stands alone as the app's generation endpoint.
